description:
Find code nothing runs: functions no production entry point (endpoint, CLI command, cron job, event handler, worker, entry file) reaches.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• Cleaning up a module or deleting a function
• Confirming new code is reached from an entry point

RETURNS: Reachability through the call graph, not text references.
• Dead: unreached, named in no other file, and no import of its file could reach it.
• Possibly unused: unreached, but named in other files (string dispatch, dynamic loading) or an import of its file could reach it. Listed with the files that name it.
• Used only by tests: exported functions and class methods only test files reference.
With `functions`: each one's status, and the call path from an entry point when it's reachable.

functions.description: Function names or Class.method names to check instead of listing everything unused

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: get_unused_code
title: Unused Code
